scopeNotes: New text needs independent review; earlier hashes do not certify it.
Map endpoints are not historical founding or extinction dates.

The imported 1492 to 1500 polygon lies near Tocantínia in Tocantins. Identity is interpreted as Xerente on that geographical evidence and the attested self-name; boundaries remain unverified. Akwen as a broader linguistic designation must not collapse Xerente, Xavante and Xakriabá.

The basket thesis title and cataloguing pages say 2021; the approval page gives 9 February 2022 and repository deposit occurred in 2023. The card does not misdate the object using those publication dates. Its known 2006 gift is not a manufacturing date.
Basket figures on printed pages 33 and 35 were visually inspected. Author observation of an object is distinguished from interviews with makers, which pandemic restrictions prevented.

The two food studies are different projects: Porteira and Funil in 2013 to 2014; participatory food-heritage research in 2019 to 2020. Claims about particular villages or interviewees are not universalized.
No present-day population estimate, health causal claim, claim that mango is native, or universal cessation of cultural practices is reproduced from the older food study.
The ISA account contains old present-tense statistics and approximate later Funil demarcation chronology. These are not used as current statistics or assigned a precise legal year.
The GATI nursery and brigade activities are described at the report period; no current membership count or completed ecological restoration is inferred.
Independent historical review, geometry assessment and depth certification remain pending.
